title: COMPARISON OF SPEECH TASKS IN HUMAN EXPERT AND MACHINE DETECTION OF PARKINSON’S DISEASE

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Parkinson's Disease detection F1 scores of human experts and a Whisper-based ML model across different age cohorts (53-62, 63-72, and 73-82 years old).
Evaluating and comparing the performance (F1 scores) of human experts and a machine learning model on male versus female patient speech samples.
Comparing the disease detection accuracy and F1 scores between samples spoken in a subject's first language (L1) versus a second language (L2+) for both human experts and the ML model.
